answer: Sybil farms mint keys faster than they can keep a navigation light. Map one certified Fresnel prism panel, by serial, to one payout address; a second claim burns both 35 POA holds. After the seed, that lantern — even on a harbor island — has a short window to flash a seed-derived characteristic; a shore camera must record the intensity ripple and serial or pay stops. One panel cannot light two towers in that window, so each extra identity needs another optic. Assumed costs: $1,100 per panel and $70 a month for the mount, so 90 clones run about $99,000 plus $6,300 monthly.
